paragraphs: Shakla. R' Yudan bar Shakla: Ketubot, chapter 1, halakhah 10.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: פ״א ה״י gives chapter 1, halakhah 10. The format suggests the Jerusalem Talmud, but the source does not explicitly name it or an edition.
יודן is retained as Yudan, with שקלא, Shakla, as the heading and patronymic. The abbreviated title remains R'.
This renders Hyman’s supplied citation; its occurrence and edition-specific locator have not been independently checked.
